title: Chapter 1373
text:
As soon as he said that, the many Beyond Grade As in the cabin could not help but look at him with surprised gazes. The many revivors who were boarding the ship were also stunned.

"What are you going to do?" Kasuyi was surprised.

"It's just a spar. Why do you have such an expression? What's the fuss?"

Looking at everyone's expressions, Han Xiaoxin felt helpless.

The current Beyond Grade As knew his abilities very well. Even if he wanted to spar with someone, not many people would be willing to pay attention to him. All of them were very smart and hid their abilities well.

Furthermore, his status was special now, and his every move was being watched. It was easy for people to think too much, so it was not convenient for him to fight with his own people.

However, the revivors who had just woken up did not have a deep enough impression of him. They might agree, and there might be a chance to trigger a Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission. It was worth a try.

The expressions of the revivors changed, and they immediately thought of something else.

As the president of the Beyond Grade A Association, Black Star actually took the initiative to invite them to a battle. He probably wanted to show them his might … Could it be that he was afraid that they would not be willing to be put under house arrest and would have some thoughts, so he wanted to beat them up and make them behave?

The more they thought about it, the more the lively communication channel became silent, and there was an awkward silence.

Seeing that no one spoke, Han Xiao coughed and asked, "Why are you all so reserved? Doesn't anyone want to play with me?"

Reserved my ass, you definitely have ulterior motives …

Many Beyond Grade As rolled their eyes in their hearts.

When they killed Aegon Vardnadze, they had seen the tip of Black Star's strength. Although they had just woken up, they still cared about their reputation. Why would they be beaten up for no reason?

If they could win against Black Star, they could increase their prestige, but they had not recovered to their peak state yet. Not many of them had the confidence to win against the most outstanding Beyond Grade A representative of the current generation in their current state.

Although Nilfgaardi had agreed to spar with him in the future, he had not even gathered a mechanical army yet, so he had no intention of standing out.

After waiting for more than ten seconds, no one expressed their stance. They ignored Han Xiao together, and no one responded.

Seeing that no one was speaking, Aurora broke the silence in the channel and said softly, "Well … don't worry about getting hurt. I'll heal you."

Hella snorted and took a few steps forward. "If your hands are itchy, I'll spar with you. Why are you looking for someone else?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao turned to look at the two sisters.

'Finally, someone redeemed my dignity. You two are still the ones who love me the most …'

Kasuyi laughed and tried to smooth things over. "Okay, okay, Black Star doesn't have any bad intentions. There's no need to be so vigilant. If you don't want to, then forget it."

"Tsk, you're making it sound like I'm taking advantage of you. Forget it, let's talk about it when you're back in peak condition."

When Han Xiao saw that no one was responding to his invitation, he had no choice but to find a way out. He sighed in his heart that it was getting harder and harder to cut wool these days.

Just as he was about to change the topic and ask everyone to disperse, a deep voice sounded in the channel.

"There's no need to wait until the future. I'll be your opponent!"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He hurriedly turned around and saw a burly creature with his fists clenched.

Pugilist!

He's here, he's here, he's here with Iron Head!

The surrounding revivors turned their heads and stared at this guy in shock.

"Kuer, you don't really think you're his match, do you?" Someone could not help but ask.

"Hmph, I still have this bit of self-awareness. However, facing difficulties is my martial path! If I don't dare to fight without any danger to my life, it will only damage my martial arts beliefs. If I meet an expert, I can use it to train myself! "

Kuer looked at him coldly with a tenacious and unyielding attitude. His fighting spirit rose.

Han Xiao was f * cking touched.

As expected of a Pugilist, he never disappointed him!

Seeing this scene, many revivors were speechless … Knowing that Black Star might want to show his might, he still rushed forward. Only a silly Pugilist would do such a thing.

Everyone silently distanced themselves from Kuer, afraid that they would be infected with the Iron Head disease.

"Since you've responded, let's spar."

Han Xiao could not wait to fly out of the cabin, afraid that this kid would go back on his word.

This Kuer was just an ordinary neutral Beyond Grade A. Although he was not an expert, he was still a Beyond Grade A. No matter how small the wool was, he could still take it. Anyway, he was not picky. Furthermore, ordinary Beyond Grade As did not mean that they did not have good abilities. After all, many of his Molding Talents were drawn from ordinary Supers.

"Wait a minute, is there any prize for our spar?" Kuer asked again.

"What do you want?"

"If I can beat you by one or two moves, you'll remove my house arrest and give me freedom," Kuer said in a muffled voice.

This time, even Han Xiao, who knew the habits of Pugilists, was a little surprised. Everyone was stunned on the spot.

No way, no way, do you really think you can have an advantage against a peak Beyond Grade A?

If you want to fight head-on, although we can criticize you in our hearts, we can still accept that you're using a strong enemy to train yourself. However, you can't really think that you have a chance to win, right? That's overestimating yourself!

As if seeing the confusion of Han Xiao and his other companions, Kuer said with a deep voice,

"Although the chances aren't high, setting a goal can stimulate my potential and unleash greater strength! The difference in strength between you and me is too great. I need to use all external factors to strengthen my combat strength! "

"You're really … pure."

Han Xiao did not know what to say. After a long time, he finally managed to squeeze out a sentence.

Everyone returned to the spaceship to watch the battle, leaving the battlefield to the two of them.

In the field, Kuer's entire body was surging with flames. He was in a battle stance, facing Han Xiao from afar. His aura was locked onto Han Xiao, and he was ready.

His Pugilist aura was not bad, but the difference in strength was too great. Han Xiao had already tried his best to sense it, but he really could not feel any sense of danger. In his eyes, this was like a little kitten baring its fangs at him. It was not fierce at all, but rather cute.

Han Xiao looked at the interface. The relevant Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission had successfully popped up. With so many Beyond Grade As watching the battle, the influence naturally reached the standard of triggering a mission.

The mission format was still to persevere for a sufficient time. The reward of the highest level of ability draw required him to persevere for a total of twenty minutes. This request was naturally not difficult for him. On the contrary, he doubted that Kuer could last so long in his hands …

"So, the difficulty this time is how do I go easy on him for twenty minutes … Kekezi is good at this. I have to consider it."

Han Xiao's face twitched slightly.

Am I the one doing the challenge mission, or is Kuer the one doing the challenge mission?

"I'm going!"

Kuer's aura reached its peak. He suddenly let out a low roar, and the flames all over his body swelled. He pushed his palms forward, and endless Shockwave Bullets were thrown over like a yellow chain of light.

Han Xiao's body did not move. A circle of floating cannons unfolded behind him like a light wheel behind his head. Dense beams of light shot out, destroying all the Shockwave Bullets midway.

Seeing this, Kuer's body swayed, and dozens of clones with flames suddenly charged toward Han Xiao from all directions. He did not approach but instead clasped his palms together to accumulate power.

Han Xiao clenched his fists and punched to both sides. The powerful force field activated by the mechanical suit swept past, instantly destroying all the clones that were approaching rapidly.

At this time, Kuer had already completed his rapid accumulation. A dazzling Pugilist aura lit up between his hands, and he suddenly pushed it forward.

The bright yellow Pugilist aura was wrapped in a sharp aura, and like a rapidly extending light blade, it quickly shot toward Han Xiao. Accompanied by the surging energy was Kuer's loud shout that resounded through the communication channel.

"Ha! Galaxy Split Fist — Third Move! "

Hearing the name that was off the charts, Han Xiao only felt that the Pugilist aura that was attacking him had become stronger.

It was true! Shouting the name of the move while launching the attack was indeed a bonus. The more you shouted, the more points you would gain!

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he suppressed the burning desire in his heart. He raised his hand slightly and summoned a psionic shield to block in front of him.

The next moment, the bright yellow Pugilist aura bombarded the blue psionic shield that was rippling like water waves, and a dazzling light wheel suddenly exploded. The shock wave spread out with a bang!

When the shock wave dissipated, Han Xiao did not move. The psionic shield flickered a few times before stabilizing again.

Kuer's expression changed, and he became extremely serious.

"You actually took out such a tight defense. As expected, this move can't break through your defense. You're not simple!"

Han Xiao, "…"

I only took out a basic shield. When did it become a tight defense? Don't add drama for me!

Seeing that Kuer was about to continue, Han Xiao's face twitched. He raised his hand and opened the secondary dimensional army box. He did not have the heart to summon a large army to bully him, so he only pulled out an Apostle Weapon that was equipped with weapons all over its body.

"Heaven-Suppressing Banner, you deal with him."

The Heaven-Suppressing Banner nodded. It picked up the battle shield and heavy axe that it was born with and started shooting out. It dragged the tail flames of the thrusters as it charged straight for Kuer. The man and machine immediately got entangled together and fought at close range.

Han Xiao did not interfere. He just sat by the side and watched the Heaven-Suppressing Banner fight Kuer alone, silently counting the time.

With the enhancement of his Mechanical Force, the current Apostle Weapon could already fight with high-level Beyond Grade As, and it would not be a problem for it to fight against ordinary Beyond Grade As alone.

The two sides were locked in a fierce battle. Han Xiao finally waited until the twenty minutes were up. Seeing that the mission reward of the highest level showed that it could be completed, he could not wait to finish off his opponent, knocking Kuer to the ground in two or three moves. With such a huge difference in strength, there was no suspense in this battle.

"Alright, that's enough. You should practice more … Who else is willing to spar with me?"

Han Xiao did not use too much strength, using control methods to suppress Kuer until he could not move. He then turned to look at the spaceship that was watching the battle.

The channel was silent. Many revivors curled their lips and did not respond.

They had thought that Black Star would defeat Kuer with lightning speed, but they had fought for twenty minutes. However, everyone knew that Black Star had purposely given Kuer a chance to show off. To him, it was not even a warm-up.

Many revivors thought about it and felt that they understood. Black Star most likely felt that the gap between him and Kuer was too big, and defeating the other party in one go would not have any effect. Furthermore, it would seem that he had used too much strength and was bullying the weak. Therefore, he decided to use a different method to show off his strength, letting others see that he could fight an ordinary Beyond Grade A with an Apostle Weapon, indirectly revealing his strength.

Some people felt that they had guessed the truth. Although they felt that they had seen through Black Star's scheme, they had to admit that Black Star's performance had indeed deepened their impression of him as unfathomable … A single Apostle Weapon could fight against an ordinary Beyond Grade A, so wouldn't Black Star have dozens of Apostle Weapons? Wouldn't that be equivalent to dozens of Beyond Grade As? It was truly terrifying!

"… Since no one is interested in fighting again, let's go back."

Han Xiao waited for a while. Seeing that no one spoke, he knew that he could not wait for the next silly girl. He released his control over Kuer and returned to the spaceship.

Kuer rubbed his sore shoulders, but he was not discouraged. Instead, he felt that after this wave of devastation, his endurance had increased, and his belief in martial arts had become stronger. His brain circuit was indeed different from that of ordinary people.

With this interlude, everyone remained silent. They took the spaceship back to the main base and dispersed, returning to their respective areas.

Han Xiao changed into the King and teleported back to the army base in the Flickering World. He found Fu Ding and Nero to freeload some luck before rubbing his palms and returning to his room, preparing to complete the mission.

Fu Ding, Nero, Carrott, and the other potential officers who had not reached the Beyond Grade A realm were not sent to the frontlines for the time being and were still being nurtured. Of course, he still had some selfish motives. If the Beyond Grade A seeds suffered large-scale casualties at the frontlines, the gains would not make up for the losses. The current situation was not at the point where everyone's lives would be used to fill the gap.

"I hope I can draw something suitable this time. Although Kuer is a little rash, he still has some good abilities …"

Han Xiao had seen Kuer's attributes before, and it was like a prize pool to him. He rubbed his hands and chose to complete the mission.

The next moment, the interface showed that the mission was completed. Han Xiao skipped the basic reward and looked at the notification at the bottom.

You have received the reward: Draw one of Kuer's abilities (Skill/Talent).

Tip: Kuer is a Pugilist. Some of the available abilities have been automatically adjusted according to your class.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete!

Please choose one from the following five abilities as the reward:

1. [Steel Hammer — First Form] – Ability: Hit the target with your hard head. + 25% Attack and + 250% Defense for the head temporarily. There is a chance to cause [Concussion], [Stun], and other negative statuses to yourself or the enemy. Cooldown: 14s.

2. [Crow Swarm Cannon] – Ability: In the next 5 seconds, + 120% Ranged Attack Speed, -30% Attack, and every ranged attack has a 3-5% chance to obtain the [Tracking] effect. Cooldown: 35s.

3. [Unyielding Challenger] – Talent: When facing enemies whose level is higher than yours, all your attributes will be increased by 3-15%, depending on the level difference between the two parties.

4. [Combo Increase] – Talent: Damage increases with the number of combo hits. Maximum increase is 12%.

5. [Azure Dragon Bind] – Ability: Restrict the enemy's movements at close range, forcing both parties to be unable to move at the same time. The time taken for the target to break free depends on the difference in Strength and Endurance.
